# **Inside the 'Crazy Bonkers' CBS London All-Hands**

I've [reported](https://www.the-independent.com/news/world/americas/us-
politics/cbs-news-bari-weiss-editorial-call-b2841070.html)
[extensively](https://zeteo.com/p/bari-weisss-cbs-60-minutes-pelley) on Bari
Weiss's [year-long](https://www.the-independent.com/news/world/americas/us-
politics/bari-weiss-cbs-news-standards-and-practices-b2862631.html) [reign of
terror](https://zeteo.com/p/bari-weiss-mad-colbert-late-show-cbs) atop CBS
News. I've heard about [newsroom clashes](https://zeteo.com/p/anderson-cooper-
bari-weiss-cbs-behind-the-scenes) with Weiss and her deputies, and concerns
over the **David Ellison** -installed leadership
[injecting](https://zeteo.com/p/bari-weiss-cbs-iran-war-dukoupil) their [pro-
Israel](https://zeteo.com/p/bari-weiss-meddles-with-cbs-sunday) and [other
biases](https://www.the-independent.com/news/world/americas/us-politics/bari-
weiss-60-minutes-cecot-email-b2890289.html) into the network's coverage.

But what I heard on audio I obtained from yesterday's "crazy bonkers"
editorial meeting at the CBS London bureau in the aftermath of press coverage
of the network's handling of an Oct. 7 story is unlike anything I've ever
heard. You won't believe what she said about **Benjamin Netanyahu** , or what
she called the Palestinian death toll in Gaza. She also had a blunt warning
for staffers who cross her.
